summary: The current implementation routes multi-byte ByString delimiters through LiteralPolicy, whose Find uses find_first_of and whose Length returns 1. This treats each delimiter byte as a separate match, producing the extra empty fields in the reported tests. The supplied implementation and contract excerpts are sufficient to identify the repair location and intended literal matching behavior.
hypotheses: LiteralPolicy uses character-set matching and consumes one byte instead of finding and consuming the full literal delimiter; this causes the APIExamples, UTF8, and SubstrDelimiter failures.
